description: The reviewed list of auth tables for the production SQL runner's L1 shape gate (pipeline/src/prod-sql.ts). A table appears here ONLY with an explicit classification and a cited source. The gate stops on any auth table that is not listed, and on any table classified 'credential-bearing: STOP'. This file is pinned by SHA-256 in prod-sql.ts: a change needs a reviewed change to that pin. Evidence: the staging-2 auth schema capture of 2026-11-01 (27 tables, names and types only, no row data), classified in docs/build-plan/18-production-sql-route-options.md. That is staging-2 evidence and NOT proof of production parity. Auth release: (not verified). Thirteen tables are classified STOP, so the gate refuses on a database with this schema until L1 is extended by a separately reviewed change or the owner accepts the risk.

tables.source: staging-2 auth schema capture of 2026-11-01 (kept outside the repository), columns payload (json), ip_address, created_at, instance_id, also recorded in supabase/tests/a3/harness/auth-staging2-mirror.json; event log; no token, secret, hash or code column; the json payload content cannot be proven by a names-and-types capture (assumption recorded in the note)
tables.note: Assumption: the json payload holds event metadata only (Supabase Auth audit log). Not provable from a names-and-types capture; unlike SCIM, no standard defines a credential attribute for it. A separately approved content check would be needed to prove it.

tables.source: staging-2 auth schema capture of 2026-11-01 (kept outside the repository), columns client_secret (text, NOT NULL), client_id, also recorded in supabase/tests/a3/harness/auth-staging2-mirror.json; holds an OAuth provider client secret; L1 does not clear it

supabase/rollout/L1-close-legacy-auth.sql (STEP 3 delete, STEP 4 recount); docs/build-plan/14-same-origin-signin-design.md section 11.6; staging-2 auth schema capture of 2026-11-01 (kept outside the repository), columns auth_code, provider_access_token, provider_refresh_token, invite_token, also recorded in supabase/tests/a3/harness/auth-staging2-mirror.json

staging-2 auth schema capture of 2026-11-01 (kept outside the repository), columns provider_id, identity_data (jsonb), provider, email, user_id, also recorded in supabase/tests/a3/harness/auth-staging2-mirror.json; links a user to an external provider identity; no token, secret, hash or code column; identity_data is provider profile claims per Supabase Auth docs, content not provable from the capture (assumption recorded in the note)
tables.note: Assumption: identity_data holds provider profile claims, not tokens (Supabase identities docs). Not provable from the capture; unlike SCIM, no standard defines a credential attribute for it. Provider sign-in is closed at O2 before L1.
